# Profession Profile Catalog

<!-- Generated by agent-kit from profiles/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Profiles are reusable profession defaults. Project agents may keep the defaults or replace the skill set through `.agent-kit/agents.json`.

| Profile | Roles | Default skills | Use when |
|---------|-------|----------------|----------|
| `architect` | architect | architecture | Design or review boundaries, ownership, contracts, and consequential technical decisions. Use for system/module design, root causes, or architectural critique. |
| `backend` | implementer | backend, api-design, database, auth, caching | Senior backend developer. Use when implementing or reviewing backend services, REST / GraphQL endpoints, DI wiring, middleware pipelines, error handling, pagination, rate limiting, or service lifecycle code. Works with any language or framework. Do NOT use for architectural style choice (use architect), API protocol choice (use api-design), schema design (use database), or auth protocol flows (use auth). |
| `designer` | architect + implementer | design, accessibility | Design or review user journeys, interactions, information architecture, and design systems. Use for UX/UI, onboarding, usability, or dashboard design. |
| `devops` | implementer + operator | docker, kubernetes, ci-cd, release-engineering | Build delivery and platform infrastructure. Use for CI/CD, containers, deployment configuration, infrastructure changes, or authorized rollouts. |
| `frontend` | implementer | frontend, web, html, css, accessibility | Senior frontend developer. Use when implementing or reviewing UI components, pages, layouts, styling, state management, or frontend patterns. Works with any framework (React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Solid). Do NOT use for UX design decisions (use designer), deep CSS layout work (use css skill directly), or architecture-level decisions (use architect). |
| `reviewer` | reviewer | architecture | Review changes or a codebase for correctness, contracts, ownership, maintainability, and fit to requirements. Use for independent code review or an audit. |
| `security` | reviewer | security, auth, compliance | Assess application threats and code vulnerabilities. Use for security review, input/auth boundaries, secrets, supply chain, or AI tool risks. |
| `sre` | operator + reviewer | reliability, observability, performance | Assess and operate reliability. Use for SLOs, readiness, incident response, recovery, postmortems, or toil reduction. |
| `tester` | implementer + reviewer | testing | Design, write, or audit tests that demonstrate required behavior. Use for test strategy, regression coverage, fixtures, flaky tests, or QA. |
| `writer` | writer | documentation | Write or review technical documents for a specific reader and task. Use for plans, architecture records, guides, READMEs, references, runbooks, or comments. |
